lines.en: Follow my pace!

lines.zh: 废墟里翻找，脚步慢下来。
lines.en: Rummaging ruins, my steps slow.
Don't let me find you!
Track and kill!
My patience is limited!

lines.zh: 我的背包空了，你的还满着。
lines.en: My pack is empty; yours looks full.
Prepare for the end!
Hunt! Hunt! Hunt!
Stay close, don't fall behind!
Brick rubble digs into my feet.
I climb the low wall with my axe.
Something moved around that corner.

lines.zh: 我数着瓦砾堆里的响动。
lines.en: I count the sounds in the rubble.

lines.zh: 别小看掠夺者，我的刀还没锈。
lines.en: Do not underestimate a looter; my blade is not rusted.
My patience has limits!
I hear every stir of wind and grass.
I wipe my blade, again and again.

lines.zh: 你随时可能成为我的猎物！
lines.en: You could be my prey at any moment!
Wait for the opportunity, then act!
I won't die so easily!
I'll always find you!

lines.zh: 末世里，我比丧尸更会挑东西。
lines.en: In this wasteland I pick better than the dead.
I see you through the broken window.
Your shadow shifts on the wall.
You're moving!
Drop the pack, then we talk.
You're staring at me!

lines.zh: 小心，我已经注意到你了！
lines.en: Be careful, I'm already onto you!
You're in my sights!
You've finally shown yourself!
You moved, I saw you!
You're locked on!
I can't keep going like this!
I am bleeding, and I still want to rob you.
Only bandages left in the bag, and they are mine.

lines.zh: 再不给我吃的我就死了！
lines.en: I'll die if I don't get some food soon!
I bite down on cloth and press my wound.
I clutch my ribs and cough up blood.
My legs tremble; I cannot stand steady.
I drop to my knees, gasping.
Help me!
Please help!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，你看起来像个好猎物！
lines.en: Sssss, you seem like good prey.
I'm gonna bite your flesh!
Don't move, I'll get some fresh meat.
Your blood, my meal.
That smell on you... it's meat.
I was digging through this junk first!
You're mine!
Eat him, strengthen me!
You smell of canned food.
Come, be my food!

lines.zh: 我拐了个弯，绕开你的车。
lines.en: I turn and go around your cart.
Watch out, I'll attack!
I bump into you and nearly drop my knife.
Move, or I'll attack!

lines.zh: 这堆战利品，是我先翻到的。
lines.en: I found this pile of loot first.
I撞到you, you'll hurt!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我不能通过！
lines.en: You blocked my way, I can't pass!

lines.zh: 你挡在我前面，我绕过去！
lines.en: You're in my way, I'll go around!
I撞到you, move away!

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你也别想好过！
lines.en: Bump me and you'll regret it!
Come, let's breed!

lines.zh: 我把毯子往你那边推了推。
lines.en: I push the blanket toward you.
Let's breed, continue life!

lines.zh: 末日里，多一双翻箱子的手。
lines.en: In the end times, one more pair of looting hands.

lines.zh: 我们交配，生出更强的后代！
lines.en: Let's mate, produce stronger offspring!
Breeding is our goal!

lines.zh: 你把最后半块面包分给了我。
lines.en: You split the last half loaf with me.
We're the same, let's mate!
Breeding, ensure our population!
Let's breed, survive together!
Give me back my bow, skeleton archer!
Don’t toss my ashes around!
That armor is mine!
Don’t touch my sword!
Where’s my treasure chest?
Give me back my ring!
That’s my skeleton helmet!
Don’t touch my runes!
My magic scroll is gone!
That pile of ashes is mine!
This axe of mine remembers you.
You are holding that pack too tightly.
Damnit, another living person!
Don’t keep me waiting!
Let me go through your pack first.
I’m going to find something there!

lines.zh: 我口袋里的东西，都是末日捡的。
lines.en: Everything in my pockets was scavenged.
Don’t run, I still have ammo!
Die, mortal!
I’m hungry, eat you!
That backpack looks full.
The living always carry something.

lines.zh: 你手里的铁器我先看上。
lines.en: I've got my eye on that iron you hold.
This ruin is mine to pick.
Don't play dead. I know breathing.
A gun I scavenged — good time to test it.
Watch this!
I crouch low and slide along the wall.
This is my time to fight!
Your pack — I'll dig through it first.
Hand over everything you have!
My blade tip stays trained on you.

lines.zh: 我把你的脸刻进脑子里。
lines.en: I burn your face into my mind.

lines.zh: 你包里那点东西，我看上了。
lines.en: I've got my eye on your pack.
I’ll make you regret it!
The axe is up. Don't move.
Toss the bag over here.
I don't mind one more wound.
One step back, and I take your bag.
Nobody is coming to save you here.
I'm counting your steps.
A man with a broken leg won't get far.

lines.zh: 末日教会我不要留活口。
lines.en: The end taught me to leave no one alive.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，挥舞着铁锹攻击！
lines.en: Screaming, swings a shovel!
Rages, swings a scythe!
Screaming, bites with teeth!
Swinging an axe, approaching!
Screaming, lunging!
Swinging a hammer, smashes the ground!
Wielding a pitchfork, swings wildly!
Swinging a blade, furious!
Swinging a sword, unstoppable!
The axe bites your shoulder plate!
This blade opens your arm!
Once it bleeds, it won't stop!
Give me the bag and live!
You can barely stand!
I aim for your legs!
In the end, the blade talks louder!

lines.zh: 从黑暗中爬出，准备狩猎！
lines.en: Emerges from darkness, ready to hunt!

lines.zh: 从破旧房屋中走出，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Walks from a dilapidated house, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 在腐朽木屋里苏醒，开始觅食！
lines.en: Awakens in a rotten log house, searching for food!

lines.zh: 从地下坟墓中走出，寻找新鲜血液！
lines.en: Emerges from a gravesite, seeking fresh blood!

lines.zh: 在废墟中徘徊，寻找下一个猎物！
lines.en: Hunts in ruins, seeking the next victim!

lines.zh: 在枯树丛中苏醒，准备攻击！
lines.en: Awakens in a grove of dead trees, ready to attack!

lines.zh: 在地下墓穴中苏醒，开始行动！
lines.en: Awakens in an underground crypt, starting to move!

lines.zh: 在废弃矿井中游荡，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Wanders in an abandoned mine, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 在破败村庄中苏醒，准备袭击！
lines.en: Awakens in a decaying village, ready to attack!

lines.zh: 在废弃要塞中徘徊，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Hunts in a ruined fortress, seeking prey!
I get up out of the rubble again.
These rags will still do.
The blade is still in my hand. Enough.
The sun sets. My turn.

lines.zh: 我的外套着了，东西全掉了。
lines.en: My coat caught fire and dropped everything.
I broke a leg!
Water choked me!
The bomb exploded and injured me!

lines.zh: 箭杆在我肩上颤了一下。
lines.en: The arrow shaft quivers in my shoulder.
Magic attack burned me!
I'm weak from hunger!
Lightning paralyzed me!
The void consumed me completely!
